themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize nationals over immigrants in housing, social benefits, and employment. This theme has seen strong convergence, particularly in Spain, Italy, and Hungary, where such policies are being formalized in regional and national legislation.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in housing and social policies in regional coalitions with PP, threatening to withdraw support if not implemented.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports 'national preference' in housing and labor policies, with Salvini pushing for stricter immigration controls.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Proposes 'national priority' in housing and employment, with Bardella advocating for stricter immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Government holds closed-door meetings during Pride events, signaling alignment with anti-immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Criticizes EU migration policies and advocates for prioritizing Polish citizens in social benefits.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni diplomatic fallout escalates
themes.blurb: The diplomatic tensions between former U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni have intensified, with both leaders engaging in public disputes over photo requests, Iran policy, and mutual accusations. This theme has seen strong convergence in Italy, the U.S., and France.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump accuses Meloni of 'begging' for a photo at the G7 summit and criticizes her stance on Iran.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni denies Trump's claims and defends Italy's sovereignty, leading to public disputes and canceled meetings.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Covers the fallout as part of broader critiques of U.S.-Europe relations and far-right diplomacy.
